title: Hazbin Hotel
description: In attempt to find a non-violent alternative for reducing Hell’s overpopulation, the daughter of Lucifer opens a rehabilitation hotel that offers a group of misfit demons a chance at redemption.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Charlie pitches Heaven her plan to save sinners by way of redeeming themselves through her Hotel. Vaggie enlists the staff to make a commercial to promote the hotel.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The Vee's: Vox, Velvette, and Valentino rule their corner of Hell unchallenged, but Alastor's return to the airwaves may shake things up. Meanwhile, a new Hotel guest tests Angel's patience.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: While the Hotel's guests and crew spend the day learning about trust, information revealed at a meeting of overlords leads to a respectless dispute.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Angel struggles to juggle his work and his time at the Hotel. Charlie decides it's time to put her ‘Princess' status to use with Angel's boss.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Charlie struggles with asking her father, Lucifer, for help. Meanwhile, an unexpected new arrival shakes things up at the Hotel.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Charlie and Vaggie make their way to Heaven to speak to Adam's manager. Meanwhile an explosive reunion gives Angel the opportunity to show how far he's come.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: With secrets revealed and the Hotel in the crosshairs, Charlie and Vaggie must do what they can to protect their home from destruction by any means necessary.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: All bets are off as the confrontation between the legions of Heaven and Hell begins.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Charlie's victory against Heaven has sinners flocking to the newly rebuilt Hazbin Hotel. But can she make sure they're all there for the right reasons? Meanwhile, Vox reveals his plan for the Vees to gain their ultimate victory.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Sir Pentious' redemption creates a stir in Heaven, but not everyone is happy to see a sinner redeemed.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Charlie invites Voxtek to do a piece on the Hotel and Pentious' redemption. But she will need hard proof to convince her skeptical guests.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Charlie tries to do damage control by going live on television! Meanwhile, Alastor reaches his final straw.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Vox hosts a rally for his increasing supporters. Meanwhile, Charlie looks to Heaven for help.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Vox leads the overlords toward war with Heaven. Tensions run high at the hotel and Husk returns to his old ways.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Vox unveils his secret weapon, giving Heaven their final warning.

episodes_data.title: Hazbin Hotel Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Vox (and the Vees, I guess) is hosting a party so everyone can watch him take over Heaven - and you're all invited!
